gaps.explanation: Statement pp7-8 Total revenues 9,887,886 = General 3,545,538 + Keno 1,737,143 + Street 1,661,224 + LB 840 352,611 + Downtown Development 325,733 + Nonmajor 2,265,637. Detail: budget-basis schedules (pp15-19) General 5,898,049, Keno 1,768,475, Streets 2,094,444, LB 840 623,753, Downtown Development 539,306, plus the nonmajor combining statement pp20-21 2,265,637 (ties to the Nonmajor column) = 13,189,664. Per fund the budget-basis actuals exceed the GAAP columns: General +2,352,511, Keno +31,332, Streets +433,220, LB 840 +271,142, Downtown +213,573; sum 3,301,778 = gap. The budget basis counts interfund transfers in and loan repayments inside revenues ('Local'; GAAP shows General transfers in 2,600,643, Downtown transfers in 252,386 and LB 840 payments received from loan 255,293 under other financing) and has no fair-value interest losses (GAAP interest income General (19,467), Keno (24,818), Street (8,409)). The trimmed pages have no line-by-line budget-to-GAAP reconciliation, so the per-fund difference cannot be itemized beyond this; no line is missing or duplicated (the nonmajor funds tie exactly). Different basis; no fix.

Statement pp7-8 Total expenditures 11,629,614 = General 4,894,254 + Keno 1,773,371 + Street 1,853,772 + LB 840 476,696 + Downtown 1,287,075 + Nonmajor 1,344,446. Detail: General p15 7,138,843 + Keno p16 1,773,370 + Streets p17 1,850,013 + LB 840 p18 476,697 + Downtown p19 1,422,700 + nonmajor pp20-21 1,344,446 (ties) = 14,006,069. The budget schedules count transfers out as expenditures; different basis, no fix (removing lines would drop printed schedule amounts).

Statement p8 Operating transfers in 2,180,000 = General 2,600,643 + Downtown Development 252,386 + Nonmajor 213,181 - Eliminations 886,210. Detail transfers in 213,181 come only from the nonmajor combining statement (pp20-21: Economic Development 55,422? no - transfers 213,181 recorded per fund). The General and Downtown budget-basis schedules (pp15, 19) print no transfer lines: their transfers are inside budget-basis revenues/expenditures. 2,600,643 + 252,386 - 886,210 = 1,966,819 = gap. Adding the statement transfers would count that money twice (it is already in the budget-basis Local revenue lines). Different basis; no fix.

Statement p8 Operating transfers out (2,335,628) = General (2,244,924) + Downtown Development (135,625) + Nonmajor (841,289) + Eliminations 886,210. Detail transfers out 841,289 = Sales Tax Fund (nonmajor combining p20). The General and Downtown transfers out are included in their budget-basis expenditures (p15 General expenditures 7,138,843 vs GAAP 4,894,254; p19 Downtown 1,422,700 vs 1,287,075 = 135,625). 2,244,924 + 135,625 - 886,210 = 1,494,339 = gap. Different basis; no fix.
